description: CUR-POP (F: why the ORDER BY snapshot of the first card reported 2048 at open), variant: a snapshot opened on the plain TABLE name 'Big' (2048 rows). Part 1: RecordCount at open, after a field read, after MoveNext, Move 9, 90, 400 and 1500 (RecordCount and AbsolutePosition each), MoveLast. Part 2 (a new snapshot): read ID and V of row 1, then another call runs UPDATE Big SET V = 'chg' WHERE ID IN (2, 1000, 2000) (dbFailOnError); MoveFirst and ID and V are read, then Move 1, 998, 1000 (cumulative) reading ID and V each time. Decides whether the count at open and the fixing of values follow ORDER BY or table size.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
